recipes.name: Golden Vegan Hot Chocolate
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a blender, and blend until smooth*.
Transfer to a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium-high heat. Stir continuously to prevent scorching the milk.
When heated through, remove from heat, transfer into your desired cups and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * The dates provide natural sweetness, but also add a slight graininess to the drink. For a smoother texture, use maple syrup instead and omit the blender. Simply add the ingredients to the saucepan.
